observations: Photo 0: IBC tote tank in metal cage frame on a plastic/composite pallet base, white plastic container visible through cage, black discharge valve at bottom, a red/white instruction sticker on front face.
Photo 1: Closer view of the same tote cage top and valve area, metal cage looks painted gray with some wear, a barcode sticker visible near top edge, blue cap on discharge valve.

Photo 2: Close-up of embossed lettering on the plastic body showing partial numbers '...100' and '250 LTR ...' and a date-type code, consistent with standard IBC manufacturing markings, not a clear single capacity readout.
No shot shows the top fill lid open or closed, no shot shows the underside/pallet condition, no shot shows interior of tank, no shot shows full cage for dents/rust on all sides.

identity.kind: IBC tote tank (intermediate bulk container), cage-type, approx. 1000L class

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: Intended use claim, not something a photo can confirm or deny.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No photo shows any food-grade certification mark, prior content label, or interior condition; embossing in photo 2 is a manufacturing code, not a food-grade or usage proof.
Only partial exterior faces shown in photos 0-2; base, rear face, and valve seal under pressure are not shown, so cracks/leaks cannot be ruled out.
No photo shows the top lid/cap in clear view, open or closed.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or stress fractures on unseen faces or base
risks.proof: Clear photos of all four side panels and the underside/pallet base
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, assume possible damage

risks.risk: Prior contents may not actually have been food-grade water as claimed (could have held chemicals, affecting safety for reuse)
risks.proof: Photo of original content label/UN markings on the tote, or interior photo showing no residue/staining
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/contaminated-risk, not as certified food-grade

risks.risk: Valve or seal leak not apparent from static photos
risks.proof: Short video of valve being opened and closed, showing water flow and no drip after closing
Close-up photo of the top fill lid removed and reseated

risks.risk: Cage corrosion or bent bars reducing structural safety for stacking/transport
risks.proof: Full-frame photo of cage in daylight showing all welds and corners

proof_requests: Photo of all four exterior panels in daylight
Photo/video of the top lid opened and closed
Video of the discharge valve opened and closed to check for leaks
Photo of any original content or hazard label still on the tote
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standard cage-type IBC tote, but none of the seller's condition or food-grade claims are shown in the photos, so it must be priced at worst-case (unverified food-grade status, unverified leak/crack/lid condition).
